channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: Canada's Connor McDavid Challenges Single-Olympic Record For Most Points By An NHLer
item.description: Team Canada's Connor McDavid is already halfway to breaking the record for most points by an NHL player in a single Olympics tournament. But as Canada clinches Group A, McDavid's not here for the record.

item.title: 'I Feel Terribly': Switzerland, Canada Wish Kevin Fiala The Best After Leaving Game On Stretcher
item.description: Players from Canada and Switzerland left the bench to tap their sticks as Swiss star Kevin Fiala left the final moments of their round-robin game on a stretcher with what appeared to be a lower-body injury.

item.title: What Is Team Sweden Doing With Filip Forsberg At The Olympics?
item.description: Team Sweden's Olympic hockey coach is making some bewildering ice time choices when it comes to the minimal ice time for Filip Forsberg, writes Adam Proteau.

item.title: The Hockey News Big Show At The Games: Reacting To Canada And Finland's Friday Wins At Olympics
item.description: From Milan, Ryan Kennedy helps break down Canada and Finland's wins in men's hockey action on Friday with Andrew McInnis and Michael Augello.

item.title: 'Take His Age Out Of It': McDavid, MacKinnon And Others Praise Celebrini's Impact At Olympics
item.description: Macklin Celebrini was seven years old when Sidney Crosby last won gold at the 2014 Olympics. Now, the 19-year-old Celebrini is playing on the same team as the 38-year-old captain, and he's on a line with superstars.

item.title: Olympic Men's Hockey: Why Slovakia Won Group B Despite Losing To Sweden
item.description: Team Slovakia clinched Group B despite losing 5-3 to Sweden after Finland beat Italy 10-0. Here's how the tiebreaker process worked.

item.title: Maple Leafs' Matthews, Jets' Hellebuyck Must Lead Team USA To No. 1 Seed
item.description: Maple Leafs center Auston Matthews and Jets goalie Connor Hellebuyck starred in Team USA's first win. They'll need to keep it up when they play to build a large enough goal differential to clinch the No. 1 overall seed over Canada.

item.title: Connor McDavid Faces Enormous Expectations With Oilers And Canada
item.description: The year 2026 could be massive for Edmonton Oilers and Team Canada superstar Connor McDavid. But for a player who said how important it is for him to win something, the expectations to get it done this year are huge.

item.title: How Does Thomas Harley Keep Picking Up The Slack For Canada?
item.description: Whether it's the 4 Nations Face-Off or the Olympics, Canada can rely on Thomas Harley to step up when another D-man gets hurt. His Norris Trophy and Stanley Cup-winning defense partner even loves to play with him.

item.title: Team USA Gets A Reality Check In Olympic Men's Hockey
item.description: Team USA's dominant start to the Olympics in Game 1 turned into a closer-than-expected victory over Denmark in Game 2. Their chances of clinching the top overall seed took a hit, but they dealt with some adversity effectively.
